tasks.short: Confer with cleaners on performance problems and company policies.

steps.what: Note the performance or personnel problem a cleaner reports
Read the company policy that fits that problem
Confer with the cleaner about the problem and the policy
Accept the personnel note that states the outcome
File the accepted personnel note in the record

tasks.design: The {HCM} files only the personnel note the housekeeping supervisor accepted after she conferred with the cleaner. The note holds the policy name and the outcome she stated. It does not record a sickness cause, and it does not decide the outcome.
tasks.previous_blocker: The outcome lived in the talk, and a later note was easy to fill with a sickness cause.
tasks.enabler_now: A personnel record can store only the fields she already stated, and refuse a row that holds a sickness cause.
tasks.still_hard: She still holds the talk and judges the person. The file does not know whether the cleaner understood the policy.
tasks.human_edge: She hears what the cleaner will not write down, and she decides whether the problem is the policy or the person.

ambition.what: She discusses a changed company policy with the crew the week it changes, instead of waiting until a problem appears.

tasks.altitude: The confer stays her week. She decides the outcome. Only the retyping of a note she has already accepted leaves her hands.

reach.task: Bring a policy question with the fact, not a sickness cause.
reach.learn: Which policy name belongs on the note.

evidence.claim: Filing a note about a named cleaner in a staff system is staff data, so works council consent applies under WOR art. 27(k).
The AP fined a maintenance company for recording sickness causes and leaving absence records online without authentication. This note must not store a sickness cause.
The talk with the cleaner stays with the supervisor. Filing her accepted wording does not shorten that talk. Model knowledge.

assumptions: The focal workflow is the performance talk. Note fields are the cleaner name, the date, the policy name, and the outcome she stated. She produces the problem in s1 and the outcome in s4. If she has not stated an outcome, s5 does not run and she keeps the paper note.
The cleaner is a colleague. The confer is a talk, not a send outside the organisation.
Upkeep is two hours per 100 baseline hours to keep the policy names current. It is not zero.
unknowns: Whether the personnel system already has a free-text note, or only fixed warning codes.
research_questions: How often a confer ends with a written outcome rather than a spoken one.

already_counted.description: She re-reads the outcome wording while accepting the note in s4.

incremental.description: She keeps the list of policy names the note may cite.

approvals.approved_version: personnel note she accepted in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A week where the problem stays spoken and she files nothing, versus a week where every confer ends in a short outcome she already stated. High is 3, under the net of 6.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate a cleaner's work and recommend a personnel action.

steps.what: Read recent work notes for that employee
Watch that employee's performance and note the facts
Decide among promotions, transfers, dismissals, or no change
Accept the personnel actions she will recommend
Tell the cleaner those personnel actions in person
File the accepted personnel recommendation
Send the accepted recommendation to the hr adviser

tasks.design: The {HCM} files the personnel recommendation she accepted, and {EMAIL} sends that same version to the hr adviser inside the organisation. Nothing is scored. A promotion, a transfer, or a dismissal stays her decision, and the record holds no sickness cause.
tasks.previous_blocker: The recommendation was retyped into a form, and a copied score could have stood in for her decision.
tasks.enabler_now: The record and the internal mail can carry only a version she has already worded, with the action named by her.
tasks.still_hard: Watching the work and choosing the action stays hers. A wrong dismissal is hard to undo.
tasks.human_edge: She knows the work on that site, and she can explain the action to the cleaner in the room.
tasks.altitude: She still evaluates the person and chooses the action. The file and the internal mail only repeat the wording she accepted.

reach.role: Janitors and Cleaners, Except Maids and Housekeeping Cleaners
reach.task: Hear which personnel action was recommended and why.
reach.learn: The difference between a transfer and a dismissal on this crew.

evidence.claim: An automated performance decision with significant effect needs human intervention and a right to contest. This recommendation stays her decision.
Storing the recommendation on a named cleaner is staff data under WOR art. 27(k).
An AI system that scores cleaners is high-risk under Annex III 4(b). This design does not score anyone.
The AP fined a maintenance company for recording sickness causes. The recommendation must not store one.
She watches the work and chooses the action. The file and the internal mail only copy the version she accepted. Model knowledge.

assumptions: Recommendation fields are the action (promotions, transfers, dismissals, or no change), the work facts she noted, and the wording she accepted. She produces the facts in s2 and the wording in s4. If that wording is missing, s6 and s7 do not run and she writes the form herself.
The hr adviser is inside the organisation. The mail in s7 is an internal send, not a send outside, so its authority is write_internal. It is still its own gated step.
Upkeep is three hours per 100 baseline hours for a send that names the wrong action. It is not zero.
unknowns: Whether a dismissal must be countersigned by HR before the internal send. If so, the send waits, and this design does not count that person's time.
research_questions: What share of recommendations are dismissals rather than promotions or transfers.

already_counted.description: She re-reads the work facts while accepting the wording in s4.

incremental.description: She corrects a send when the action name does not match the wording she accepted.

approvals.approved_version: personnel recommendation she accepted in s4
personnel recommendation she accepted in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A month with no personnel action to file, versus a month where each recommendation is wording she already accepted and the internal mail only copies it. High is 6, under the net of 13.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend changes that improve cleaning service and efficiency.

steps.what: Note where operational efficiency drops on site
Draft changes that improve service from her notes

loop.input: Her site notes naming the place, what she saw, and the change she wants.
loop.output: A short change note whose every sentence cites one of those notes.
loop.check: Each sentence names a place and a change that her note already states.
loop.stop: Stop when a sentence adds a place or a change she did not note. If the notes lack a place or a change, this step does not run.
loop.why_not_simpler: Her notes are free text, so a fixed form cannot line each sentence up with the place she named.

steps.what: Check each cited sentence against her site note
Accept the service changes that match her notes
File the accepted service changes
Present the accepted changes to the operations lead

tasks.design: A bounded draft turns her site notes into service changes, and she checks that each sentence cites a place and a change she noted. The {DOCS} store files only the version she accepted. She presents that version to the operations lead herself. The draft does not score a cleaner.
tasks.previous_blocker: The change note was rewritten from memory after the walk, so the place and the method drifted.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can line each sentence up with a note she made, and stop when it adds a change.
tasks.still_hard: She still has to see the site. A draft cannot tell whether the operations lead will take the change.
tasks.human_edge: She sees the room, and she decides which failure is worth a change.

ambition.what: She recommends a method change the week a place fails, while her site note is still fresh.

tasks.altitude: The walk and the choice of what to change stay hers. She spends less time rewriting a note that only repeats her own sentences.

reach.role: First-Line Supervisors of Landscaping, Lawn Service, and Groundskeeping Workers
reach.task: Recommend a method change from a site note that names the place.
reach.learn: Write the place and the change before asking for a draft.

evidence.claim: An AI system that scores cleaners or allocates shifts from behaviour is high-risk under Annex III 4(b). This draft does neither. It only restates a place and a change she already noted.
She checks the meaning of each sentence against her own note, then accepts the version that is filed. The walk is not shortened. Model knowledge.

assumptions: Note fields are the place, what she saw, and the change she wants. She produces them on the walk in s1. If a note lacks a place or a change, s2 does not run and she writes the recommendation in s4.
The operations lead is a colleague. Presenting the change is a talk, not a send outside the organisation.
The draft must not name a cleaner. Upkeep is three hours per 100 baseline hours when a sentence cites her note but changes the method. It is not zero.
unknowns: Whether the client contract requires the recommendation to be sent outside. This design does not send it.
research_questions: How often her notes already name a place and a change, versus a week of looking only.

already_counted.description: She checks each sentence against the site note in s3.

incremental.description: She rewrites a sentence that cited her note but changed the method.

approvals.approved_version: service changes she accepted in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A week where her notes name no place and no change, so no draft runs, versus a week where every sentence matches a note she made. High is 8, under the net of 19.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Screen cleaner applicants and hire the people she chooses.

steps.what: Read applicants for the open cleaner vacancy
Screen applicants for availability and right to work
Interview the applicants she kept for the role
Decide which applicants to hire as employees
Accept the offer terms for those employees
File the accepted decision to hire those employees
Send the accepted offer to the applicant she chose

tasks.design: She screens and interviews applicants herself. No ranking is applied. The {HCM} files the hiring decision only after she accepts the offer terms, and {EMAIL} sends that same offer to the applicant. The interview is a talk, not a send.
tasks.previous_blocker: The offer was retyped from notes, so hours and pay could change after she had decided.
tasks.enabler_now: The personnel record and the offer mail can use only the terms she accepted, and they do not rank applicants.
tasks.still_hard: She still screens and interviews. The letter does not know whether the person will do the work.
tasks.human_edge: She judges who can do the cleaning work on that site. A form cannot make that judgement.
tasks.altitude: She still chooses whom to hire. The record and the offer only repeat hours, start date, and pay she has already stated.

reach.task: Show availability and right to work before the interview.
reach.learn: Which fields a complete application must contain.

evidence.claim: A hiring record in a staff system is staff data, so works council consent applies under WOR art. 27(k).
The cleaning cao runs from 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2028, and generally binding status was requested. Offer hours and pay she writes should follow that cao where it applies.
The AP fined a maintenance company for recording sickness causes. The hiring record must not store one.
She screens and interviews. The letter only repeats terms she accepted, and nothing ranks the applicants. Model knowledge.

assumptions: Offer fields are the applicant, the hours, the start date, and the pay she states. She produces them in s5. If those fields are missing, s6 and s7 do not run and she writes the letter herself. The applicant submitted the application; she does not extract a score from it.
The applicant is outside the organisation, so the offer in s7 is act_external and has its own gate. The interview is a talk, not a send.
Upkeep is three hours per 100 baseline hours when sent hours differ from the terms she accepted. It is not zero.
unknowns: Whether HR, not the supervisor, sends the offer letter. If HR sends it, her send step does not apply.
research_questions: What share of applicants arrive with availability and right to work already filled.

already_counted.description: She re-reads hours, start date, and pay while accepting the offer in s5.

incremental.description: She corrects an offer when the sent hours differ from the terms she accepted.

approvals.approved_version: offer terms she accepted in s5
offer terms she accepted in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A month with no hire, or a month where HR sends the letter, versus a month where every offer repeats hours and pay she already wrote. High is 6, under the net of 13.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still supervises the crew on site. The talks, the interviews, and the personnel decisions stay hers. Less of the week goes to retyping a note or an offer she has already worded.
reach: Janitors and Cleaners, Except Maids and Housekeeping Cleaners
skills_to_grow: Write the outcome, the policy name, and the place before a record is filed.
State offer hours and pay herself so the letter only repeats them.
role.ambitious_version: She raises a changed policy with the crew the week it changes, and she recommends a method change while the failed place is still fresh, without scoring any cleaner.
